title: Nutritious Smoky Kenyan Corn Arepa Quesadilla
description: Charred, fluffy Kenyan corn arepas filled with melted mozzarella and a smoky seasoning, a hangover cure packed with nutrients.
instructions: Whisk the corn flour, all-purpose flour, salt, baking powder, black pepper, smoked paprika, and garlic powder in a bowl.
Add the water and mix until a soft dough forms, then let it rest for 5 minutes.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and drizzle a thin layer of olive oil.
Roll the dough into thin circles about 6 inches in diameter and cook each side until golden and charred, about 2 minutes per side.
Sprinkle shredded mozzarella cheese evenly over one half of each arepa while still warm.
Fold the other half over the cheese and press gently to seal.
Continue cooking the folded arepas for another 2 minutes until the cheese melts.
Remove from skillet and let them cool slightly before cutting into wedges.
Garnish the wedges with fresh cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
Serve immediately and enjoy the smoky, comforting flavor.

axes.primaryIngredient: corn arepa filled with mozarella cheese
